label: Durability level
type: the per-write setting specifying how far a mutation must propagate before the write is acknowledged. Distinct from sdk:transaction-durability, which is the transaction-scoped setting, and from the SDK-side sdk:durability extraction-layer id.
note: Promoted with two of its values. Note the deliberate non-merge with sdk:transaction-durability, an existing record: that one is a transaction's durability setting and this is a single mutation's, and while they take related values they are set in different places and documented as different options.
